claim.text: Hazard onset was at 5.90 s and impact was 2.10 s later.
The hazard onset reason was closing.
Perception took 0.24 s, below the 0.30 s perception threshold.
Command took 0.05 s, below the 0.10 s command threshold.
Brake actuation took 0.58 s, above the 0.25 s actuation threshold.
The nominal counterfactual showed no contact.
The nominal counterfactual minimum gap was 4.57 m.
The witness and the recheck both reported the other vehicle's brake lights were not illuminated.
